g.text: Search and lens chips at the top + an expandable evidence shelf below the map.
Layout study only | All sites, boundaries and values are invented.
Non-building area is not necessarily unused. Next: check yard use.
Wide map. Lenses live above it; a shallow evidence shelf sits below.
Example: low building coverage invites a yard-use check, not a severance promise.
On close: return to the earlier view only if the user has not moved the map.
